brands.evidence: Yes, absolutely. Monzo is a fully licensed UK bank, and millions of people use it as their sole or primary bank account

client_claims.text: Monzo is a fully licensed UK bank
client_claims.note: Consistent with UK bank authorised by the PRA and regulated by FCA/PRA.

client_claims.text: Monzo is regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA).
Eligible deposits are protected up to £85,000 under the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS).
client_claims.note: Fact says FSCS protection is up to £120,000 per person, not £85,000.

client_claims.text: Millions of people use it as their sole or primary bank account for their salary, bills, and everyday spending.
client_claims.note: Facts give customer numbers (15.2m) but not how many use it as a main account.

client_claims.text: Monzo can spot the incoming Bacs payment and lets you claim your salary at 4:00 PM on the working day before it is due.
Monzo is part of the Current Account Switch Service (CASS) and switches are completed within 7 working days.
Cash deposits at PayPoint cost typically £1 per deposit unless on higher-tier plans.
Customer support and account management are handled entirely through the app.
